publication_decisions.captured_wallet_receipts: Publish only under receipt label after raw event-key audit; not buybacks or holder distribution
publication_decisions.executed_buybacks: Not established by inspected evidence; do not publish synthetic purchase history
publication_decisions.buyback_yield: Blocked without verified executed USD purchase numerator and aligned market-cap or FDV denominator; retained receipts/FDV is not buyback yield
publication_decisions.burns: Protocol fee burns and treasury purchases are distinct. Wallet balance or withdrawal does not establish burn.
publication_decisions.unlock_chart: Historical announced schedule possible after exact category/source verification; no future genesis cliff implied after month sixty

analyst_conclusion: The economically important distinction is deployment, not a wallet label: fee capture can grow before market purchases are verified. Present captured receipts as measurable capital available to governance, and require matched acquisition evidence before claiming investor-directed token demand. Historical allocation contextualizes initial distribution; current supply change is the more relevant ongoing dilution measure.
